notes: New Route screen: a progress ring, Map or List view, a Next Stop card, To Do and Done tabs, and drive miles and time.
Switch between Route, Winterization, Testing and Forecast with the tabs at the top. No Back button needed.
Home shows a Today card with your next stop and anything that needs attention.
Customer cards have Call, Text, Map and Remind buttons and one big Start Test button.
The test form numbers each reading, keeps Pass and Fail at the bottom, and shows a review step before you finish.
Invoices and Bookings are simpler: one Approve button, with the rest under More.
The sync icon shows a status dot and says Offline when you have no signal.
